# IPC (Integrated Positronic Chassis)
IPCs are fully synthetic humanoids, equipped with a positronic brain that grants them sentience. Unlike organic crew members, IPCs operate on entirely mechanical systems and require unique maintenance procedures.
## Unique Characteristics
IPCs are [color=#1e90ff]completely immune to biological hazards[/color], including: - Toxins and poisons - Radiation exposure - Suffocation and pressure damage - Bleeding and diseases - Food and drink requirements
However, they have significant vulnerabilities: - [color=#ffa500]Take 250% damage from Shock sources[/color] - [color=#ff6347]Highly vulnerable to EMPs[/color] - [color=#ffa500]Cannot heal naturally over time[/color] - Require constant power to function
## Temperature Regulation
IPCs have specialized thermal characteristics: - [color=#87ceeb]Much slower temperature changes[/color] than organic species (takes longer to heat up or cool down) - [color=#ffa500]Heat damage begins at 400K (127°C)[/color] - [color=#1e90ff]Cold damage begins at 173K (-100°C)[/color] - Can operate in more extreme temperature ranges before taking damage
## Repair and Maintenance
### Physical Damage Repair
IPCs use unique healing methods: - [color=#ffff00]Welders[/color] (must be lit) repair [color=#ff6347]Brute damage[/color] - [color=#1e90ff]Cable coils[/color] repair [color=#ffa500]Burn damage[/color] - Repairs occur over time and will [color=#90ee90]automatically repeat[/color] until fully healed or supplies run out - Each repair cycle uses [color=#ffa500]5 fuel (welder)[/color] or [color=#1e90ff]5 cable (coil)[/color]
[color=#ff6347]Traditional medical supplies like bruise packs and ointment do nothing for IPCs![/color]
## Power Management
IPCs are equipped with an internal power cell that drains over time: - Can recharge from [color=#ffff00]APCs (Area Power Controllers)[/color] by interacting with them - Receive [color=#ffa500]power warnings[/color] when battery runs low - [color=#ff6347]Will shut down completely if power is fully depleted[/color] - Power cell can be removed and replaced by medical staff
[color=#1e90ff]Tip:[/color] Keep an eye on your power levels and plan recharging stops during long operations!
## Combat Considerations
IPCs have distinct tactical strengths and weaknesses:
[color=#90ee90]Advantages:[/color] - Immune to biological warfare (toxins, gas, disease) - No blood loss or bleeding wounds - Can function in extreme temperatures longer than organics - Radiation immunity makes them ideal for nuclear operations - Don't need to eat, drink, or breathe
[color=#ffa500]Disadvantages:[/color] - Tasers and stun batons deal massive damage - EMP grenades can disable systems or cause instant death - Cannot heal without specific tools - Power dependency creates vulnerability during extended operations - Slower healing compared to medical treatment for organics
## Roleplay Notes
IPCs are synthetic beings with positronic brains, giving them unique perspectives: - Often speak in more mechanical or analytical terms - May use binary emotional expressions (0s and 1s) - Question organic behaviors and biological needs - Consider efficiency and logic in decision-making - Have no biological impulses but can develop personality quirks
Remember: IPCs are sentient crew members deserving of the same rights and respect as organic species!
